## Description
Visualizes projected wealth growth over time using base R graphics. The function displays the wealth trajectory as a line plot.

## Usage

```{r}
plot_wealth(data, title = "Wealth Projection")
```

## Arguments

- `data`: Numeric vector of wealth values over time, typically monthly.
- `title`: Optional plot title. Defaults to `"Wealth Projection"`.

## Value

Invisibly returns `NULL` after drawing the plot.

## Example

```{r}
plot_wealth(real_wealth, title = "Real Wealth Projection (Inflation Adjusted)")
```
